deepScan.purpose: Ask the AI layer when the user runs a Deep Scan.

userExplain.purpose: Ask the AI layer when the user taps 'Explain' on a finding.

confirmedFinding.purpose: Ask once per newly CONFIRMED local finding of at least minSeverity, for an explanation and context.

minSeverity.purpose: Lowest severity of a confirmed local finding that triggers AI reasoning.

sceneChange.purpose: Ask when the view changes substantially (new scene).

newRelation.purpose: Ask when a new hazard-type relation appears between objects (e.g. liquid next to electronics).

ambiguousScene.purpose: Ask when the local result is uncertain: low mean detection confidence or many tentative tracks.

ambiguousMeanConfidence.purpose: Mean confidence of reported objects below which the scene is ambiguous.
ambiguousMeanConfidence.ref: Fast detector precision on coco128 is 0.89 at 0.40; scenes averaging below it are mostly uncertain detections.

periodicMs.purpose: Periodic contextual reasoning interval (0 = off). User-adjustable.
periodicMs.ref: Off by default to minimise API usage.

cooldownMs.purpose: Minimum time between automatic AI calls in one live scan (user-requested calls bypass it).
cooldownMs.ref: AI is an optional reasoning layer; local diagnostics run continuously.

maxCallsPerMinute.purpose: Hard cap enforced by the backend per scan session (also caps user-requested calls).
maxCallsPerMinute.ref: Protects against runaway costs; SCAN_AI_CALLS_PER_MINUTE env var overrides.

dedupeHamming.purpose: A frame whose 64-bit average hash differs from the last analysed frame of the scan by at most this many bits reuses the cached answer.
dedupeHamming.ref: Average hash on an 8x8 grey thumbnail; small differences are compression noise or slight jitter.

cacheTtlMs.purpose: How long a cached AI answer can be reused for a duplicate frame/scene.
cacheTtlMs.ref: Two minutes; scenes rarely stay identical longer without the user expecting fresh reasoning.

failureBackoffMs.purpose: After a retryable provider failure (rate limit, quota, timeout, network, 5xx), automatic AI calls pause for this long; user-requested calls still go through and show the error.
failureBackoffMs.ref: Avoids hammering a provider that is failing; one minute matches typical per-minute quota windows.

hardFailureBackoffMs.purpose: After a non-retryable failure (invalid key, unknown model, rejected request), automatic AI calls pause for this long.
hardFailureBackoffMs.ref: Such failures need a configuration change; retrying every few seconds would only add failed requests.

liveMaxEdge.purpose: Long edge of live frames sent to the AI provider.
liveMaxEdge.ref: Detail for scene reasoning at modest token cost.

deepMaxEdge.purpose: Long edge for Deep Scan and Image Debug.

defaultModel.purpose: Default Gemini model when GEMINI_MODEL is not set.
defaultModel.ref: google-genai 2.29.0 README (Oct 2026) uses gemini-flash-latest throughout; the -latest alias tracks the current Flash model.

temperature.ref: Low randomness for consistent JSON, some variety in wording.

maxOutputTokens.purpose: Upper bound on the response length.
maxOutputTokens.ref: A full diagnosis is ~1-3k tokens; headroom for thinking models.
